mapper.select: SELECT id FROM user_checkins WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_removed = FALSE
SELECT id FROM user_reviews WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT t.id FROM trips t WHERE t.owner_id = #{userId} AND COALESCE(t.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trip_members m WHERE m.trip_id = t.id AND m.user_id IS NOT NULL AND m.user_id <> #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACCEPTED')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_follows WHERE follower_id = #{userId} OR following_id = #{userId}
DELETE FROM user_blocks WHERE blocker_id = #{userId} OR blocked_id = #{userId}
DELETE FROM feed_feedback WHERE user_id = #{userId} OR target_user_id = #{userId}
DELETE FROM user_author_affinity WHERE viewer_id = #{userId} OR author_id = #{userId}
DELETE FROM assistant_memories WHERE conversation_id IN ( SELECT id FROM marketplace_conversations WHERE assistant_user_id = #{userId})
DELETE FROM assistant_proposals WHERE conversation_id IN ( SELECT id FROM marketplace_conversations WHERE assistant_user_id = #{userId})
DELETE FROM assistant_turns WHERE conversation_id IN ( SELECT id FROM marketplace_conversations WHERE assistant_user_id = #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_api_calls SET request_payload = NULL, response_payload = NULL, error_payload = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (request_payload IS NOT NULL OR response_payload IS NOT NULL OR error_payload IS NOT NULL)
UPDATE content_comments SET is_deleted = TRUE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = FALSE
UPDATE activity_comments SET is_deleted = TRUE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND COALESCE(is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
UPDATE meetups SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE host_user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('PENDING_REVIEW', 'APPROVED')
UPDATE meetup_participants SET status = CASE WHEN status = 'REQUESTED' THEN 'WITHDRAWN' ELSE 'LEFT' END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('REQUESTED', 'JOINED')

UPDATE users SET email = #{email}, full_name = #{fullName}, username = NULL, avatar_url = NULL, bio = NULL, social_links = '{}'::jsonb, password_hash = NULL, provider = NULL, provider_id = NULL, birth_year = NULL, time_zone = NULL, last_login_at = NULL, account_status = 'DISABLED', onboarding_completed = FALSE, deleted_at = COALESCE(deleted_at, NOW()), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
